c74object.name: evi_lpg_buchla
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Buchla Lowpass Gate emulation for your west coast synthesis fun
c74object.description:
evi_lpg_buchla is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_lpg_buchla.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_buchla.genexpr
Circuit modelled emulation of the Buchla Lowpass-Gate, unique version of a two-pole Sallen and Key filter, based on 'A Digital Model of the Buchla Lowpass-Gate' by Julian Parker and Stefano DAngelo, 2013. In evieve this is all audio rate inputs to control the voltage input to the gate, with additional features such as extra feedback resistors (@boom) and refactored code for optimal CPU usage. The code in this abstraction can be used entirely inside gen~ / GenExpr with internal oversampling (@localresample) and evi_control_lpg_buchla.gendsp for voltage control of Rf (frequency). See evi.lpg~ for an MSP version.

geninlet.name: audio
geninlet.digest: Input. Audio input to be filtered.

geninlet.name: frequency
geninlet.digest: Rf. Frequency voltage, typically fed from 'evi_controlcircuit_buchla' or better from 'evi_control_lpg_buchla'.

geninlet.name: resonance
geninlet.digest: 0..2 @default 1. Filter resonance. Effect depends on other settings, such as @boom, @lpg and @vca.

attribute.name: boom
attribute.description: Core filter/gate functionality. Only has effect if the 'lpg' attribute is on (> 1). Smoothly crossfades additional resistors into the feedback path while maintaining filter stability. This can have a drastic effect on the tone of the filter and the resonance behaviour.

attribute.name: controlres
attribute.description: If on (1), resonance is no longer controlled by inlet 3 and is instead controlled by the @resonance parameter. Default off.

attribute.name: controlrf
attribute.description: If on (1), Rf (frequency) is no longer controlled by inlet 2 and is instead controlled by the @rf parameter. Default off, on would be atypical behaviour.

attribute.name: localresample
attribute.description: Oversampling factor. evi_lpg_buchla should always be oversampled for normal usage. 0 = 1x, 1 = 2x, 2 = 3x, 3 = 4x (default), 4 = 6x, 5 = 8x.

attribute.name: lpg
attribute.description: Core filter/gate functionality. Smoothly switch or interpolate between filter and gate behaviour.

attribute.name: nonlin
attribute.description: Turning this off is atypical behaviour. On (the default) engages the nonlinearities in the filter/gate structure. However, it can be very interesting triggering it linearly, but if you do so be careful of overall gain. 0 = linear (1x & 2x oversampling only), 0/1 = tanh (default), 2 = cubic.

attribute.name: resonance
attribute.description: Only if @controlres == 1: parameter rate control of resonance instead of inlet 3. Smoothing time set with @smooth attribute.

attribute.name: rf
attribute.description: Only if @controlrf == 1: parameter rate control of Rf voltage (frequency) instead of inlet 2. Smoothing time set with @rfsmooth and @rfhz attributes.

attribute.name: rfhz
attribute.description: Hz component of the 'rfsmooth' function. You will almost never want 'rfsmooth' to be on (@rfsmooth > 0), especially if driving from 'evi_controlcircuit_buchla.gendsp'.

attribute.name: rfsmooth
attribute.description: ms component of the 'rfsmooth' function. You will almost never want 'rfsmooth' to be on (> 0), especially if driving from 'evi_controlcircuit_buchla.gendsp'.

attribute.name: smooth
attribute.description: Smoothing time in ms for the 'vca' and 'res' controls (if selected).

attribute.name: vca
attribute.description: Core filter/gate functionality. Smoothly switch or interpolate between LPG and VCA behaviour. Using the block as a pure VCA is useful but far less fun. Ultimately this can be thought of as a gate damping effect, darkening the tone. Smoothing time set with @smooth attribute.
